description: This file defines an immutable class 'ImmutableMessageHeaders' that implements the 'MessageHeaders' interface. It provides methods to access various message-related headers, such as direction, subject, thing entity ID, feature ID, timestamp, and status code. It extends 'AbstractDittoHeaders' and offers static factory methods for creation.

classes.name: ImmutableMessageHeaders
classes.description: Immutable implementation of MessageHeaders, wrapping DittoHeaders and providing accessors for message header fields.

methods.name: of
methods.description: Creates an ImmutableMessageHeaders instance from DittoHeaders, checking for null.

methods.name: getDirection
methods.description: Retrieves the message direction header and converts it to MessageDirection enum.

methods.name: getSubject
methods.description: Returns the subject header as a String.

methods.name: getThingEntityId
methods.description: Returns the ThingId derived from the 'thing ID' header.

methods.name: getFeatureId
methods.description: Retrieves the feature ID header if present.

methods.name: getTimestamp
methods.description: Retrieves and parses the timestamp header if present.

methods.name: getStatusCode
methods.description: Retrieves and parses the status code header if present.

methods.name: getSpecificDefinitionByKey
methods.description: Finds specific header definitions by key, prioritizing DittoHeaderDefinition and then MessageHeaderDefinition.

methods.name: toString
methods.description: Overrides Object's toString to include class name and super toString output.
